info.title: Vernatun API
info.description: Local Vernatun API. Cookie sessions; mutations require CSRF. Contracts in the HAYAT/ImTun integration scope are checked against route validators and tests. This OpenAPI document describes callable HTTP interfaces only; it does not certify an external provider or physical-device deployment.

x-capability-status.estimates: unverified: no confirmed estimate/quotation route contract
x-capability-status.parkingPermits: unverified: no confirmed parking-permit route contract
x-capability-status.physicalEdgeIntegrations: unverified: HTTP Edge protocol tests do not prove physical Agent/device acceptance

hayatUser.name: X-Hayat-User
hayatUser.description: Expected authenticated user for a queued offline operation; mismatch is 403 scope_changed.

hayatContext.name: X-Hayat-Context
hayatContext.description: Expected current business context for a queued offline operation; mismatch is 403 scope_changed.

photoOperation.name: X-Operation-Key
photoOperation.description: Immutable photo upload UUID. Same user/context/path/raw-byte hash/version replays the existing receipt; changing payload gives 409 idempotency_conflict.

workVersion.name: X-Work-Version
workVersion.description: Expected parent request or defect version; mismatch gives 409 stale_version unless this exact upload already committed.

get.summary: HAYAT role-scoped paginated work, defect or visitor-pass queue
get.description: Active server context only: manager/dispatcher need requests.read, technician needs workorders.assigned, contractor needs defects.assigned, security needs access.validate. Modules and organization/building/unit/personal assignment scopes are enforced. Read-only repeatable-read snapshot. Status statistics and operational metrics ignore status/focus drills but include search, building, priority and authorized scope filters. Technician urgency, checklist progress and upcoming-work metrics include only the current technician's assigned work; checklist percent is null when no checklist items exist, and offline drafts are excluded.

200.description: Scoped page, counts, available buildings and server time

metrics.description: Counts use the same server-authorized scope, search, building and priority filters. Technician-only urgent, checklist and upcoming values use server-assigned work; checklist percent is null when there are no checklist items.

post.description: Accepts all transition actions supported by the route validator; execution and assignment permissions depend on the action. Idempotency keys are required for accept, cannot_perform, pause and resume.

post.description: Request and visit versions are checked atomically. Visits must start in the future and last at most 24 hours. A new proposal supersedes any existing proposed or confirmed visit.

get.summary: List documents readable in the active context
get.description: Only document metadata is returned; private storage keys are never exposed. Residents and unit owners see only records whose visibility matches their scope.

post.description: Requires documents.manage. Metadata is supplied as query parameters and bytes as an application/octet-stream body (maximum 6 MiB). PDF bytes are accepted; PNG/JPEG/WebP images are sanitized to JPEG. An idempotency key is optional.

get.description: Returns private, no-store bytes after current documents.read and visibility checks. Storage keys are never accepted from clients.

200.description: Private PDF or sanitized JPEG bytes
Versions visible in the active context without storage keys

post.summary: Upload a new immutable document version
post.description: Metadata is supplied as query parameters and file bytes as application/octet-stream. Requires documents.manage; the parent document version is compare-and-swap checked.

201.description: Created version with immutable version lineage and no storage key

409.description: Stale parent version or idempotency conflict

get.summary: Download a readable immutable document version

404.description: Document version outside authorized visibility scope
